Jun 2025 • Friends
Good place to chill I recently visited this Pub and had a fantastic experience. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, with cozy lighting and rustic decor that created a charming vibe. The staff were friendly and attentive, making sure our group was well looked after. Their selection of local ales and craft beers was impressive, and the food exceeded expectation. Live music added to the lively ambiance without being too loud. Prices were reasonable, and the pub felt like a great place to relax after work or enjoy a weekend night out. Highly recommended for all.
